messages:
milo (eng-ml): idea: tighten onboarding contracts around provenance + cost budgeting. two additions: provenance manifest (immutable artifact list + checksums) and a run budget token limiting bench spend per-run.

sana (eng-platform): +1. provenance manifest sounds good. format suggestion: list of URIs + sha256 + size + produced_by. keeps audits simple.

yuri (eng-sre): budget token is key. microbench should never be allowed to burn prod quota. propose budget fields: max_tokens, max_gpu_minutes, priority_tier. if exceeded -> automatic pause/rollback.

milo (eng-ml): also propose a compact admission response from platform: {ready:boolean, stage:string, rollback_token:string?, notes:[]}. rollback_token needed for immediate revocation.

sana (eng-platform): we'll expose that as part of the Kickoff API response. will add immutable run_id and event stream for status.

otter (product): question: what UX do customers see? show "pending deep-eval" vs "usable (microbench passed)". and surface expected ETA and cost estimate.

claire (qa): QA: manifest + seeds must be attached to every run so failures are reproducible. require a small deterministic seed subset used by quick-smoke.

yuri (eng-sre): operationally: enforce per-tenant concurrency caps and a global bench pool watermark. alert if queued runs > 100 and degrade non-critical scans.

sana (eng-platform): metric plan: emit run_budget_consumed, run_status, provenance_ok, p50/p95, kv_mismatch. hook to Console with a clickable run id to view artifacts.

milo (eng-ml): tradeoffs: stricter budgets mean slower deep-eval scheduling; looser budgets risk cost spikes. recommend sensible defaults but allow overrides with approval for enterprise tenants.

otter (product): agree. include an approvals flow in the RFC for budget increases and private deployments.

ci-bot: run queued: onboard/provenance-budget/3180304567 (quick-smoke)

milo (eng-ml): next actions: I'll draft RFC with manifest schema, budget token semantics, admission API shape, and runbook. owners: milo (design), sana (api/console), yuri (SRE/alerts), claire (QA). Will ping when draft posted.
